entries.title: Judgment: Apocalypse Survival Simulation
entries.definitive_edition: Judgment: Apocalypse Survival Simulation on Windows PC with free DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current Steam release with free DLC
primary.why: Judgment: Apocalypse Survival Simulation is documented on Steam as a Windows colony/survival strategy game from Suncrash, with Workshop support and free Desert Survival and Outposts DLC listed on the store page. No sourced console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass. Windows PC with the free DLC installed is the complete archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release and install the free Desert Survival and Outposts DLC before capture if documenting the complete official content set.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Workshop support and the free Desert Survival and Outposts DLC route.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced platform and complete official content route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform split was found; completeness is handled by installing the free DLC.

entries.remaster_caveats: Desert Survival and Outposts are DLC, not separate game entries or remasters.
